purpose: Bindings, shared-view references in owned activation and version-neutral discovery.
use: Opening a bound workspace or repairing owned activation: resolve binding and entry, then read the verified shared instruction view.
semantic_conditions: Activation refers to the verified shared view; peer-owned adapters are never rewritten or proof of adoption.
mandatory_preconditions: Persistent workspace binding and current verified entry/bootstrap reference.
postconditions_verification: Owned adapter resolves the current binding; stale references self-healed or reported as blockers.
